mapper.sql: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY apr19_call_date DESC, apr19_appr_id DESC) AS apr19_relate_stamp_id , t.* FROM ( SELECT apr17.* , CASE WHEN ${apprCntCond} THEN '(문서없음)' ELSE '' END AS apr19_appr_cnt_str FROM ( SELECT apr17_call_date AS apr19_call_date , apr17_note AS apr19_note , f_emp_kor_nm(apr17_call_emp_id) AS apr19_call_emp_nm , apr19_stamp_id AS apr19_stamp_id , apr10_stamp_nm AS apr19_stamp_nm , apr19_stamp_cnt AS apr19_stamp_cnt , apr19_out_yn AS apr19_out_yn , apr17_provide_co AS apr19_provide_co , apr17_purpose AS apr19_purpose , NULL AS apr19_stamp_seq , apr19_relate_stamp_id AS apr19_real_relate_stamp_id , apr19_stamp_date AS apr19_stamp_date , COALESCE(apr19_appr_id, ( SELECT apr18_appr_id FROM apr18_relate_corp_doc INNER JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = apr18_appr_id WHERE apr18_corp_doc_id = apr17_corp_doc_id LIMIT 1 )) AS apr19_appr_id , COALESCE(apr10_all_use_yn, 'false') AS apr19_all_use_yn FROM apr19_relate_stamp INNER JOIN apr17_corp_doc ON apr17_corp_doc_id = apr19_corp_doc_id INNER JOIN apr10_stamp ON apr10_stamp_id = apr19_stamp_id WHERE apr17_company_id = #{companyId} AND apr17_call_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{closeDate} ) apr17 LEFT OUTER JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = apr19_appr_id WHERE COALESCE(apr01_status_cd, ${noneCd}) IN ('30', ${noneCd}) /* 완료문서와 문서미연결건 */ UNION ALL SELECT apr01_reg_date AS apr19_call_date , NULL AS apr19_note , f_emp_kor_nm(apr01_reg_emp_id) AS apr19_call_emp_nm , apr01_stamp_id AS apr19_stamp_id , apr10_stamp_nm AS apr19_stamp_nm , 1 AS apr19_stamp_cnt , 'false' AS apr19_out_yn , apr01_receive_nm AS apr19_provide_co , apr01_title AS apr19_purpose , apr01_stamp_seq AS apr19_stamp_seq , NULL AS apr19_real_relate_stamp_id , ( SELECT sys10_reg_date FROM sys10_file WHERE sys10_parent_id = apr01_appr_id AND sys10_title_yn = 'true' ORDER BY sys10_file_id LIMIT 1 ) AS apr19_stamp_date , apr01_appr_id AS apr19_appr_id , COALESCE(apr10_all_use_yn, 'false') AS apr19_all_use_yn , NULL AS apr19_appr_cnt_str FROM apr01_appr INNER JOIN apr10_stamp ON apr10_stamp_id = apr01_stamp_id WHERE apr01_company_id = #{companyId} AND apr01_reg_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{closeDate} AND apr01_status_cd = '30' UNION ALL SELECT apr99_reg_date AS apr19_call_date , NULL AS apr19_note , f_emp_kor_nm(apr99_reg_emp_id) AS apr19_call_emp_nm , apr99_stamp_id AS apr19_stamp_id , apr10_stamp_nm AS apr19_stamp_nm , 1 AS apr19_stamp_cnt , 'false' AS apr19_out_yn , apr99_receive_nm AS apr19_provide_co , '<'||${disposeTag}||'style=color:#E33E31;'||'>'||'[폐기] '||'<'||'/b'||'>'||apr99_title AS apr19_purpose , apr99_stamp_seq AS apr19_stamp_seq , NULL AS apr19_real_relate_stamp_id , ( SELECT sys10_reg_date FROM sys10_file WHERE sys10_parent_id = apr99_appr_id AND sys10_title_yn = 'true' ORDER BY sys10_file_id LIMIT 1 ) AS apr19_stamp_date , apr99_appr_id AS apr19_appr_id , COALESCE(apr10_all_use_yn, 'false') AS apr19_all_use_yn , NULL AS apr19_appr_cnt_str FROM apr99_appr_del INNER JOIN apr10_stamp ON apr10_stamp_id = apr99_stamp_id WHERE apr99_company_id = #{companyId} AND apr99_reg_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{closeDate} AND apr99_status_cd = '30' ) t WHERE 1=1
AND ( ( #{orgCodeId} IN ( SELECT org10_org_code_id FROM org10_role_stamp WHERE org10_stamp_id = apr19_stamp_id ) ) OR apr19_all_use_yn = 'true' )
